Japanese_defense.role: brigade HQ and strongest surviving defensive concentration
Japanese_defense.branch_change: extra preparation days and improved alternate positions/communication/ammo dispersion increase survival of small positions under bombardment but cannot create depth on the narrow island

US_preassault_fire.ships: Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Colorado; Indianapolis, Louisville and supporting destroyers/cruisers
US_preassault_fire.result: most fixed guns and C2 nodes suppressed; many spider holes survive; combat power is fragmented rather than annihilated

Type95_counterattack.result: all destroyed by M4/75mm/direct fire after a short local shock; one LVT damaged centered, no M4 permanent loss

friendly_fire.center: one danger-close short/overshoot episode damages an LCI gunboat or nearby assault element
friendly_fire.ship: one LCI light/moderate damage centered, no sinking
friendly_fire.why_radar_does_not_eliminate_it: close-range own-force geometry, smoke/dust and communications/location error dominate; ship fire-control radar solves range/bearing to aimpoint, not exact identification of every friendly craft.

night_gate.result: no brigade-scale final charge; 30-70 isolated defenders emerge/use grenades and rifles overnight, producing small additional casualties and forcing full perimeter alert

atoll_closeout.previous_schedule_comparison: falls inside prior 26-28 Feb secure band; local combat closes about one day earlier than old 27-Feb center, but cleanup keeps 27 Feb as the logistics/security closeout date.

combined_US_casualties.note: Includes Engebi, Eniwetok Island, Parry, small night-air/sea events and friendly fire. Death/wounded split is reserved for the consolidated Allied casualty ledger.

base_activation.Engebi_regular_multi_squadron_developmen: March, with Army engineers first and Seabee takeover later
base_activation.Eniwetok_bomber_strip: construction begins after 23-24 Feb; first-plane clock centered mid-March, not immediately after capture
base_activation.anchorage: lagoon usable for assault/logistics immediately after mines/entrances are secured, but full fleet-base services take weeks

strategic.HAILSTONE_interlock: Truk cannot rescue Eniwetok; main Japanese fleet remains westward.
strategic.fast_carrier_recovery: Most HAILSTONE carriers are free to replenish/repair after 21 Feb; Catchpole did not consume them.
strategic.next_global_clock: DO NOT advance globally beyond 21 Feb until Eastern Fleet/Andaman 19-22 Feb is adjudicated. Catchpole result is a resolved future-local node to be merged later.
